1. NOTE — `clause_assign` is a verbatim hoist.

   Original and `SharedZC` have exactly the same binders and conclusion:

   > `(cl : LevelClause p m) (hcodim : cl.codim = cl.support.card) : ∃ u ..., cl.sat x ↔ ...`

   The only declaration-level changes are the permitted removal of `private` and relocation from `LeanUrat.MovesJ` to `LeanUrat.MovesJ.SharedZC`. The proof body is also verbatim.

2. NOTE — `mkFresh_codim` is a verbatim statement hoist.

   Both declarations state:

   > `∀ cl ∈ (mkFresh H n N S vOf i hi).clauses, cl.codim = cl.support.card`

   All parameters, implicit arguments, and binder order agree. Again, only `private` removal and namespace relocation differ. The pasted original proof is truncated, so only the charged statement-level verification is possible; it passes exactly.

3. NOTE — All twelve blueprint kernel rows are accounted for.

   | Blueprint row | Current disposition |
   |---|---|
   | `transfer` | `BridgeKernelsCtor.transfer` |
   | `slice_finite` | Deleted from the pack; proved as `bridge_slice_finite` |
   | `slice_bound` | `BridgeKernels.slice_bound` |

   No blueprint row is silently absent, duplicated, or replaced by a catch-all row.

4. NOTE — The structural deviations are explicitly recorded.

   The file records:

   - constructed `X/F/seam/Tpin` as parameters;
   - `transfer` in the construction-side `BridgeKernelsCtor`;
   - `slice_finite` leaving the pack after the authorized R6 success;
   - `count_tie` residing in `TreeSeam`;
   - the `boxeq` parameterization of `TransferRow`;
   - omission of any `zp` catch-all.

   These match the header’s “TRANSCRIPTION RESOLUTIONS” and row docstrings. The surviving row statements agree semantically with the blueprint entries.

5. NOTE — `realizedSelf_slice_finite` faithfully realizes the recorded R6 outcome.

   Its locus is exactly the promised family:

   > `V.thr n ≤ N ∧ MovesT.Realizes (Tm (max (V.thr n) 1)) ... V`

   Thus every tree is realized at its own level `max (thr, 1)`, bounded by `max (N, 1)`, with no additional hypothesis beyond the declared model and chart binders. This is the recorded finite-union-over-levels disposition.

6. NOTE — The downstream `bridge_slice_finite` statement is the authorized subtype repackaging.

   It proves:

   > `{T : bridgeTree n p σ | bridgeThr n p σ T ≤ N}.Finite`

   by injecting the carrier subtype into the self-realized `VTree` family. This is precisely the R6 consequence described in both BridgeD13 and BridgeKernels: `slice_finite` becomes a theorem, while only the p-uniform `slice_bound` remains open.
